:variabelen - werken in elk tekst-, link: :variabelen - work in every text, link and code field below.
Anonieme vertoningen. Inzendingen, korti: Anonymous views. Submissions, discount codes and views linked to an order are always kept. The daily figures are kept, but the breakdown by URL, language and referrer only works within this period. Default: 90 days.
Backfill geldt voor PopupViews waarvan s: Backfill applies to PopupViews whose submitted_at falls within the past X days.
Bij dubbele inzendingen rekent de nieuws: For duplicate submissions, the newsletter service handles duplicates itself. On = force everything, off = only new ones.
Decimalen toegestaan (bijv. 12.5). Leeg: Decimals allowed (e.g. 12.5). Leave empty to use the default popup percentage.
De popup-instellingen zijn opgeslagen: The popup settings have been saved
De standaard flow wordt gebruikt voor po: The default flow is used for popups that have not chosen a flow themselves. Only one flow can be the default at a time.
De tekst die in de popup naast het aanme: The text shown in the popup next to the sign-up field, stored verbatim as proof. If you leave it empty, the consent itself is still recorded with time, IP and source, just without text.
Deze winnen altijd van include-regels: These always win over include rules
Dit maakt een nieuwe flow aan met 3 stap: This creates a new flow with 3 steps (1 hour, 24 hours and 72 hours after conversion) and sets it as the active default flow. Other flows are automatically set to inactive and non-default.
Een bezoeker krijgt binnen deze tijd nie: Within this time, a visitor does not get two different popups in a row. 0 = no interval.
Er staan :totaal aanmeldingen in totaal,: There are :totaal sign-ups in total, of which :nogNooit have never been forwarded. By default, only submissions not yet sent are forwarded. Enable the toggle below to forward everything again.
Flow toepassen op bestaande popup-conver: Apply flow to existing popup conversions
Follow-up flow toepassen op bestaande in: Apply follow-up flow to existing submissions
Follow-up flow toepassen op bestaande po: Apply follow-up flow to existing popup conversions
Gebruikt de algemene Telegram-bot uit in: Uses the general Telegram bot from settings.
Gestart: :started. Al gestart: :alreadyS: Started: :started. Already started: :alreadyStarted. Canceled: :cancelled. No email: :noEmail. Emails scheduled: :scheduled.
Hoe vaak mag de kortingscode gebruikt wo: How many times may the discount code be used?
Instellingen voor popups, zoals de minim: Settings for popups, such as the minimum time between popups.
Je kunt hem nu aanpassen voordat je hem: You can now edit it before activating it.
Kies een specifieke flow voor deze popup: Choose a specific flow for this popup. Leave empty = the active flow marked as global default is used; if there is no active default, no follow-ups are sent.
Laat leeg om de code van de popup-conver: Leave empty to use the code from the popup conversion itself. Optional :variabelen
Laat leeg om geen aanbevelingen te tonen: Leave empty to show no recommendations.
Leeg laten om de default popup-geldighei: Leave empty to use the default popup validity.
Plant alsnog de emails van de flow \":na: Schedules the emails of the flow ":naam" after all for submissions of this popup that are not yet in a follow-up. Records that have already started or been canceled are skipped.
Plant alsnog de emails van deze flow voo: Schedules the emails of this flow after all for PopupViews where the visitor has already entered an email but is not yet in a follow-up flow. Records that have already started or canceled a follow-up are skipped.
Relatieve gewicht voor verdeling. 50/50: Relative weight for distribution. 50/50 = equal split.
Slechts één flow kan actief zijn tegelij: Only one flow can be active at a time. A new active flow automatically sets the previous one to inactive.
Stuur automatisch een reeks follow-up ma: Automatically send a series of follow-up emails to users who entered their email but have not ordered (yet). Stops automatically as soon as a paid order with this email address comes in.
Stuur ingevulde e-mailadressen automatis: Automatically send entered email addresses to newsletter lists.
Teveel pogingen. Probeer het later opnie: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
Toon AI-aanbevolen producten in deze pop: Show AI-recommended products in this popup.
Totaal aantal keer dat de code gebruikt: Total number of times the code can be used.
Verstuurt een synchrone test-render van: Sends a synchronous test render of this email to the given address. Also works for unsaved changes.
Voeg de emails toe die in volgorde verst: Add the emails that are sent in order after a visitor leaves their email without checking out.
Voer elke USP op een nieuwe regel in. :v: Enter each USP on a new line. :variabelen
Wordt gebruikt in de discount code, bijv: Used in the discount code, e.g. V1 gives WELKOM-V1-XXXXX
